text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's in her classic year, I hope Gold Ship can perform even better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to tell her as much after I wish her a happy new year, but…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year to you too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A new year is here… Last year's me has been reborn into this year's me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's kind of a miracle, don't you think? If Earth didn't exist or if the universe didn't exist… neither would I.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: After mulling over that mind-blowing fact, I decided to make this year all about being grateful.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm grateful for the Earth and the universe. I'm also grateful for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now, I present to you my original song, "Seasons Greetings from Frozen Winter to Newborn Spring."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Thanks for listening.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's this? Do you have something special to confess to me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Go on. Lemme hear it. Load up that pathos cannon and let 'er rip!
choice_data_list: Let's make a big splash in the Classics this year!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Huh? The Classics?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I actually wanted to learn how to shred some sick guitar this year…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then again, learning to play classical violin would be an awesome way to flip people's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm interested! Tell me more! How do you think I should be styling my performances?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't think we're on the same page, but anyway…
choice_data_list: Let's train you up for long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that makes sense. Stamina's important for extra long performances.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There are some pretty long pieces when it comes to the classics. Some of them are longer than ten hours.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted! I don't care if I gotta perform for ten or even twenty hours—I'll play every single note to the end!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh! So you're the type that respects your band members' opinions, huh? Good on you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: After all, when bands break up, they always say it's 'cause of "creative differences" or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's iron those differences out before they crop up! Hit me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hold up… A world tour? Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The good ol' "go big or go home" spiel, huh? Yeah, that's some blazing passion you got there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And I'm right behind you! Let's hit the studio right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If we're doing this, we're topping the charts all the way!
